capabilities: Render lists in quotes, nested code blocks and list markers in Live Preview as Reading view does
Render footnote references, definitions and back links like Reading view
Hide %% comments and match paragraph spacing in Reading view to blank lines in the source
Highlight code with Reading view's Prism highlighter
Rewrite ordered list numbers in the source and renumber lists when items change level
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; must be installed manually from release files. Designed for the Hidontknow theme — spacing may not match with other themes. Rescans the whole note on every change, so very long notes may feel slower.
intentEvidence: The theme makes Live Preview look exactly like Reading view.
motivation: The author wants the Hidontknow theme to make Live Preview look exactly like Reading view, and some differences come from how Obsidian's editor parses Markdown, which CSS alone cannot fix.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview parses certain Markdown differently from Reading view, so a theme cannot make the two views match with CSS alone.

relations.evidence: A companion plugin for the Hidontknow theme.

summary: Companion to the Hidontknow theme that makes Live Preview render lists, footnotes, comments and code exactly like Reading view.
